forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8680'
+title: 'Adopt EditorKit status token (^jy64ve7): delete AVK''s status badges'
+---
+**Blocked** on EK card ^jy64ve7 (on EK origin at 2524005e). It lands EK's status token (symbol plus label), harvested from AVK. editorkit-b5 sends the SHA. Don't start before then.
+
+Boundary (user, 2026-11-04): status is a generic atom in EK; compound views stay in AVK.
+
+## What
+- `swift package update` (all dependencies together) once the SHA lands.
+- Delete AVK's `StatusCaptionLabel` (Sources/AgentViewKit/Items/StatusCaptionLabel.swift) and whatever is left of `StatusSymbolImage` after the symbols card. Adopt EK's status token at every call site.
+- `ConnectionStatusChip` (Sources/AgentViewKit/Connections/ConnectionStatusChip.swift): if EK's card took it as the same chip, delete it and adopt EK's; otherwise keep it as an AVK compound view built on EK's token, and write the reason on the card.
+- Update the docc pages.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] No AVK copy of the harvested status code is left.
+- [ ] Tool call, plan and connection status use EK's token, with EK's theming.
+- [ ] The review gallery shows each status user in every status, light and dark.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] The full AVK test suite is green, with zero warnings in AVK targets.
+- [ ] Status tests move onto EK's API, or are dropped where EK covers them. Each dropped check is written on the card.
\ No newline at end of file
